jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
En Konecta, el talento marca la diferencia y sabemos que los grandes profesionales, hacen grandes compañías
Gracias a nuestro equipo, cada vez son más las empresas que confían en nosotros para que podamos brindarles la mejor experiência en cada interacción y en cada punto de contacto con sus clientes.
Por ese motivo, ampliamos nuestra plantilla de una de las grandes empresas bancarias del país con la que trabajamos y, te estamos buscando

¿Qué necesitamos de ti?
- Idioma Inglés: Avanzado
- Accesibilidad Web: Ejecución y análisis de rastreos de diferentes sitios web, y elaboración de planteamientos cualitativos y cuantitativos de oportunidades de mejora (experiência con herramientas como TAW Monitor, Wave, o similares)
- Conocimientos avanzados y experiência en procesos de mejora de accesibilidad documental (experiência en procesos de análisis y corrección de accesibilidad con herramientas como Adobe Acrobat o similares).
- Analítica web: Extracción y análisis (interpretación, resumen... y planteamiento de oportunidades de mejora) de métricas web desde distintas fuentes (como Google Analytics) y presentación de datos y conclusiones a través de informes detallados elaborados de forma autónoma.
- Experiência con QA Testing: Definición, planificación y ejecución de pruebas operativas (manuales) en CMS y otras herramientas de distintas tecnologías y nuevos desarrollos para asegurar correcto funcionamiento de las herramientas.
- Experiência en gestión y participación de proyectos web y colaboración con stakeholders, interlocutores técnicos y proveedores

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Contrato indefinido de lunes a viernes.
Horario de 9h a 18h con una hora de descanso para la comida.
Formación dentro de contrato.
Modalidad de Teletrabajo.
Salario anual bruto: 19.000€

Si tu perfil encaja con esta vacante, anímate a Konectar

jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Tester
jobs_results.description:
MercurySteam, estudio AAA español, continúa creciendo y mejorando con el afán de seguir desarrollando experiencias que emocionen a jugadores de todo el mundo y en todas las plataformas como “Castlevania Lords of Shadow”, “Spacelords”, “Metroid: Samus Returns” y “Metroid Dread”. Para ello estamos en busca de un/una Quality Assurance Tester para que se incorpore al equipo y nos acompañe en nuestras aventuras. ¿Quieres ser tú?
Requisitos mínimos

• Conocimiento de los procesos que forman parte del desarrollo de un videojuego y de los equipos involucrados en el mismo.
• Gran capacidad analítica.
• Excelente organización interpersonal.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y presentación.
• Capacidad para recibir y aplicar feedback positivamente.
• Una ética de trabajo positiva y proactiva.
Requisitos deseados

Experiencia haciendo testing de QA en juegos AA o AAA desde su concepción hasta su lanzamiento.
• Experiencia haciendo testing de Certificacion en juegos AA o AAA desde su concepción... hasta su lanzamiento.
• Experiencia trabajando con test kits de desarrollo de consolas (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo).
• Experiencia trabajando con equipos multidisciplinares amplios (+30 personas).
• Experiencia realizando reportes de bugs y gestionándolos con programas de gestión de incidencias (JIRA, Mantis).
• Experiencia trabajando con Perforce o control de versiones similar.
• Español e inglés fluido, tanto oral como escrito (nivel mínimo: B2).
Responsabilidades

Como QA Tester en MercurySteam jugarás un papel clave en el control de calidad, ayudando a crear juegos libres de bugs y creando una experiencia de usuario positiva en nuestros proyectos. Colaborarás estrechamente con un equipo de QA Testers y QA Engenieers, y tendrás contacto con equipos muy diferenciados como Diseño, Arte y Programación, para ayudar a crear una experiencia interactiva completa e inmersiva que balancee las necesidades del diseño de gameplay, la dirección de arte y la experiencia de usuario.
• Realizar testing manual del proyecto siguiendo test suites y test plans definidos por el Lead de QA.
• Reportar bugs y errores detectados.
• Realizar Verificaciones y Regressions de los bugs corregidos.
• Apoyo a las pruebas automatizadas de los QA Engenieers.
• Conocimiento del proyecto para identificar riesgos y realizar el testing adecuadamente.
Beneficios

• Hacemos juegos AAA con un gran componente artesanal en los que todos los integrantes del equipo contribuyen activamente.
• Entre 29 y 34 días de vacaciones al año: 23 de ellos a tu libre elección y el resto durante el periodo navideño y completamente financiados por el estudio.
• El equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal es algo que respetamos, protegemos e incentivamos:
• Dispondrás de hasta un mes de teletrabajo al año, dividido a tu libre elección, para que puedas organizarte con la mayor flexibilidad.
• No alimentamos la cultura del Crunch.
• Posibilidad de jornada continua todos los días y horario flexible de entrada (8 a 10 de la mañana).
• Posibilidad de participación en beneficios al tercer año.
• Seguro médico privado.
• Mejora constante de nuestras herramientas y procesos para que puedas centrarte en la creatividad.
• Excelente ambiente de trabajo en compañía de profesionales altamente cualificados, que te ayudarán a sacar partido de tu potencial.
• Salario acorde a experiencia y capacidades.

--------Contacto--------

Si quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo, envíanos tu CV y enlace a tu porfolio/reel a:
Ver el correo electrónico en stratos-ad.com Asunto: QA Tester - Nombre candidato/a

Todas las muestras recibidas se considerarán confidenciales

jobs_results.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Role: Lead QA Engineer

Company: Pearson

Division: English Language Learning

Location: Madrid, Spain (Remote or Hybrid*)

About Pearson:

Our purpose: At Pearson we ‘add life to a lifetime of learning’ so everyone can realise the life they imagine. We do this by creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. Pearson was founded in 1844 and has been built on our ability to grow with and adapt to a constantly evolving market. Our 20,000+ employees are dedicated to creating the high-quality, digital-first, accessible and sustainable resources for lifelong learning.

About English Language Learning:

In the English Language Learning (ELL) business unit, we aspire to become the world's leading destination to learn and improve English language skills. Our focus is on committed learners from around the world, who are motivated by outcomes because they want to reach their full potential through learning English.

Role overview:

The English Language... Learning (ELL) division of Pearson is looking for a talented and motivated professional to join our growing organization as a QA Lead Engineer.

As a QA Lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the robustness and reliability of our products, working closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders. You will lead our QAs, hands-on, to a quality driven mindset where we always put our customers, first, and proactively break our product to ensure that our customers get the best possible, bug free, experience.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead testing efforts across backend, frontend, mobile, and REST APIs.
• Plan and lead software testing, setting priorities in collaboration with the POs – our teams are spread across the globe
• Establish, lead, maintain and continuously improve a suite of robust testing processes throughout development, pre-production, and post-release phases.
• Continuously enhance our automated testing suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of critical system components.
• Promote high degree of QA automation as part of a CI/CD pipelines.
• Define, document and enforce best practice SDLC processes and standards.
• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and customer success managers to deeply understand customer business and use cases.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and troubleshoot defects and bugs, and working to resolve these issues in a timely manner
• Be responsible for testing tools, including but not limited to Mocha, Java + Selenide, Selenium, React Testing Library, Playright, Cypress, and Postman.
• Developing and executing test plans and test cases
• Verify the functionality and performance of software products and applications
• Developing and maintaining automated test scripts
• Participating in code reviews and providing feedback on code quality and testability
• Creating and maintaining automated test suites to increase efficiency and effectiveness
• Participating in release management processes

Qualifications & Skills:
• 6+ years of Agile ways of working, and software development cycle.
• 6+ years of experience in automation suites and manual testing
• ISTQB certification - Test Manager level – is a plus
• Proactive, curious, and driven mindset with a passion for breaking and improving software.
• Ability to deeply understand customer business needs and use cases to ensure software quality.
• Must have strong Leadership skills to support QA team members, and identify/resolve QA challenges through mentoring and guidance,
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional remote teams.
• Detail-oriented, analytical, and possess strong technical skills to ensure that the software meets the required quality standards
• Proficient in at least one programming language, preferably Java
• Experience with Agile and team collaboration tools such as JIRA
• Critical thinking skills to recommend original and productive ideas
• Ability to work effectively with agility and resilience in a fast-paced environment
• Ability to analyse data and information to identify patterns and trends that may indicate problems with the software
• Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and manage their time efficiently to meet project deadlines
• Willing to learn innovative technologies and tools to stay up to date with the latest developments in software testing
• Passion for education and learning

Pearson’s Benefits:
• 24 Days annual leave (increasing by 1 day with every 2 years of continuous service up to 30 days)
• Life insurance Policy
• Work-Life Balance Benefits
• Family Benefits
• Complementary Benefits
• Development and Training Benefits
• Access to Pearson+: Pearson´s digital library
• Discounts on books
• Development and training: a wide access to internal learning platforms and development plan

Diversity: At Pearson we value the power of an inclusive culture and a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture wheredifferences are embraced as strengths and opportunities are equal and accessible.

Flexible working: Pearson is committed to hybrid working practices and has adopted flexible remote and virtual working. Where possible our employees can choose to manage their attendance to the office more flexibly.

How to apply: Thank you for your interest in applying for a role at Pearson. Please submit an updated CV and cover letter (optional) in English. If you have any additional questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

What to expect from Pearson

Did you know Pearson is one of the 10 most innovative education companies of 2022?

At Pearson, we add life to a lifetime of learning so everyone can realize the life they imagine. We do this by creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. We are on a journey to be 100 percent digital to meet the changing needs of the global population by developing a new strategy with ambitious targets. To deliver on our strategic vision, we have five business divisions that are the foundation for the long-term growth of the company: Assessment & Qualifications, Virtual Learning, English Language Learning, Workforce Skills and Higher Education. Alongside these, we have our corporate divisions: Digital & Technology, Finance, Global Corporate Marketing & Communications, Human Resources, Legal, Strategy and Direct to Consumer. Learn more at We are Pearson.

We value the power of an inclusive culture and also a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture where differences are embraced, opportunities are accessible, consideration and respect are the norm and all individuals are supported in reaching their full potential. Through our talent, we believe that diversity, equity and inclusion make us a more innovative and vibrant place to work. People are at the center, and we are committed to building a workplace where talent can learn, grow and thrive.

Pearson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. We want a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We strive for a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities.

To learn more about Pearson’s commitment to a diverse and inclusive workforce, navigate to: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Pearson.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing ppsmhr@pearson.com.

Note that the information you provide will stay confidential and will be stored securely. It will not be seen by those involved in making decisions as part of the recruitment process.

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.company_name: ING BANK NV SUCURSAL EN ESPAÑA
jobs_results.description: At ING we are looking for QA Automation Engineer Your role and work environment: We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic QA Automation Engineer to join our Release Team of Engineering Platform Tribe. The responsibility of this team is enforcing the release process, guaranteeing the feature(s) quality delivered to our customer while reducing our cycle time. Your key responsibilities: As a QA Automation Engineer, you will: Provide regular, detailed status report on project progress, including test cases executed, bugs discovered, and bugs fixed. Pushing the existing test strategy inside the company, through advocacy and leading by example. Develop test plans that approximate real-world environments and tools that assist in product validation. QA Engineers are also responsible for driving the development process toward quality-centric methodologies. What are we looking for? Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this... role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply! Good analytical and communication skills, ability to deliver technical information at all levels within the company. A team player working as a core member of a team. Close collaboration within and across the teams of the tribe. As a QA engineer, you must have: QA methodologies (e.g. shift left, test levels, test types). Experience in defining and designing test plans for acceptance criteria. Ability to automate operational process. Scripting (Python, Bash) Basic knowledge of relational data bases Create, configure and support CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) Write and perform automated tests (functional, system, regression, and integration tests) Experience with Git including branching/merging workflows Knowledge of RESTful APIs Experience working with Public Clouds (Azure, GCP or AWS) Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools. English oral and written communication skills (B2 or higher). What do we offer? The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details. Check out what is waiting for you! Be flexible my friend. Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing. Restaurant card. So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings. Our house will be your home. In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more! Health insurance. For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children). Life insurance. We help you protect what matters most to you. Flexible remuneration. In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids… Free company shuttle. It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably. Banking benefits. Special loans with more beneficial conditions. Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank. And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us! More vitality and more belonging 360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose). Physiotherapy service on site. Runners club with your own trainer. Clinics with professional, world-class athletes. Gympass service. Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+) & Leonas. Get to know Us We are a team of more than 1600 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go. A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies. And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries. We are proud to have a diverse team and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society. And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clints decide to embark on this journey. Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you! We hire people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on more responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. With around 57,000 employees in over 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities. Show us initiative and we’ll let you make a difference. ING is a great place to join. We work in a highly dynamic environment where people are trusted to make decisions and every voice gets heard. If you have an idea how to make things better, you’ll be encouraged to make it happen – regardless of your position. We’d love to meet you

jobs_results.title: QA TESTER
jobs_results.description:
Ref. IT – 33/2022

Oferta de empleo: QA Tester (Full Remote).

Nuestro cliente es una empresa IT de consultoría, servicios y desarrollo de software que trabaja en el ámbito de las Tecnologías de la Información con grandes corporaciones y multinacionales así como con aquellas empresas que, independientemente de su tamaño, pretenden innovar a través del uso racional de la tecnología.

Están especializados en Gestión de la Innovación, BI, Big Data, Análisis de Datos, Machine Learning y Data Analytics.

Seleccionamos para incorporarse a un proyecto indefinido a 1 QA TESTER y que participará en un proyecto desde cero de carácter internacional para el sector turístico y viajes.

Funciones:
• Probar historias de usuario / características como parte de las actividades de sprint.
• Diseñar especificaciones de prueba a través de historias de usuario.
• Utilizar herramientas de seguimiento de errores para su información (JIRA si es posible).
• Analizar los resultados de las pruebas y los reporta... a los roles de SCRUM
• Construir herramientas para apoyar el desarrollo y las funciones del negocio.
• Desarrollar herramientas de pruebas internas (marco) para mejorar los sistemas de calidad de las pruebas.
• Alertar cuando sea probable que un problema importante ponga en peligro todo el proyecto
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los roles de garantía de calidad y otros departamentos para garantizar productos de calidad, con entregables y plazos claros del proyecto, y para garantizar la finalización oportuna de los entregables.
• Participar en un equipo pequeño, experimentado y enérgico en un cronograma de entrega rápido y ágil.

Skills:
• Entre 4 y 6 años de experiencia trabajando como QA Tester.
• Experiencia de entre 1 y 2 años con Selenium.
• Conocimientos o experiencia en Cypress, Postman, Rest Assured es un plus.
• Dispuesto a aprender y compartir conocimiento con el equipo de desarrollo.
• Experiencia en informes y documentación de problemas técnicos.
• Nivel de Inglés B2 o intermedio (sin certificar).

Valorable (NO OBLIGATORIO):
• Experiencia con GitHub u otras herramientas de CI/CD.
• Conocimientos en Python.
• Conocimientos en scripting.
• Conocimientos en testing multiplataforma

Se ofrece:
• Contratación directa e indefinida con nuestro cliente.
• Ubicación: Trabajo FULL REMOTE, podrás trabajar desde donde quieras.
• Salario: 36.000 – 42.000 euros brutos anuales.
• Formar parte de un proyecto profesional sólido y con futuro de una compañía en expansión.
• Formación a cargo de la empresa.

Si estás interesad@ puedes aplicar tu candidatura enviando tu CV a través del formulario de contacto de esta página.

¡Muchas gracias

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.company_name: ESML SD Iberia Holding S A U
jobs_results.description: Senior QA Engineer– Marketing & Sales Do you want to make an impact every day by keeping people safe - and by bringing them a sense of security and peace of mind? Interested in being part of a dedicated, passionate team that believes that security is a human right? Looking to join a company where innovation and technology are at the heart of its solutions? Join us today! Present in more than 17 countries across Europe and Latin America, Verisure Securitas Direct is a leader specializing in developing products and services in the home security sector. We are an award-winning ‘Internet of Things company, having amassed a ton of experience and expertise for over more than 30 years. Unlike many competitors, we keep most work in-house to guarantee premium quality every step of the way. Our office in Madrid is a top R&D Center in the connected smart home market. Here we create and develop services and products for home security and home automation. We are looking for people who can make a... tangible positive impact in delivering breakthrough innovation in Research & Development to transform and add value, not only to our Company but the industry itself. Main Responsibilities We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who set up and lead the QA strategy for the Marketing and Sales domains in our 17 Countries. Define and implement the test strategy of the Global Marketing and Sales IT department. Align this implementation and tools used with the QA discipline in the company. Collaborate with the discipline with create the best in class QA processes in the company. Define the way of working regarding QA aligned with the product owner, technical lead and scrum master. Lead the execution of this QA strategy and implementation of this way of working in each of the scrum teams aligned with the priorities and situation of each project. Manage performance of the QA test together with the product owners and technical leads of each team (6-7 people). Work together with the Service/Maintenance team, QA team and developers to drive to 0 the bugs in production. Implement a continuous improvement mindset within the QA team and other members of the company with the objective of maximize the quality in production. Improve testing processes like implementation of E2E scenarios which covers critical processes. Define and lead the implementation of the testing automation strategy. Lead the implementation of the device farm project and promote the usage in the company. Build reports to understand the QA situation within the teams. Report status of implementation of the strategy to middle and senior management. Competencies Strategic mindset and leadership skills to lead a team and the implementation of the strategy. 5+ years’ experience leading QA teams 10+ years’ experience in testing Experience with testing plugin in JIRA, Confluence. Experience with devices farm tools (Google, AWS, Saculelabs) Experience with testing automation tools (selenium, webdriver.io, apium) Experience working in international environment Experience managing senior management stakeholders Functional understanding of the marketing and sales business Experience with Agile Methodologies/lean and tools: JIRA, Confluence, etc. Ability to clearly communicate with peers, manager and senior managers Ability to function with new technologies Requirements Education: Master/ B.A in Computer Engineer or Telecommunications English B2 Other Competencies: Service culture, continuous improvement mindset Critical thinking and problem solving abilities to address complex issues involving data movement and data replication Proactive and dynamic person Must be a self-starter as well as a good team player. Good communication skills. Leadership skills to help technical lead with the team motivation to learn new methodologies. We Offer Passion for our People We believe that we make a difference every day. To do that, we need committed and engaged employees. Our people are accountable for delivering world-class service and they are passionate about making the world a safer and more secure place. Our teams operate with integrity and respect for one another fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit. We are building a high-performance organization through investing in our people with great development and growth opportunities. We also offer hybrid working model. Passion for Innovation We are a growth company. Our continuous investment in innovation has led to consistent top and bottom-line growth. The more we grow, the safer the world becomes. Our Investors We are owned by a leading private equity firm: Hellman & Friedman. Our sponsor has invested in our innovation pipeline and in our organization to fuel our accelerated growth and play a leading role in the industry. We are Verisure – and we are Proud to Protect Verisure is the leading provider of professionally-monitored smart alarms for residential households and small businesses in Europe, and we are growing in Latin America. We trade as Verisure in most of the countries where we operate, and as Securitas Direct in Spain and Portugal. We protect more than three million customers in 16 countries. Our business model integrates product development, design and sales with installation, outstanding service and a 24/7 professional monitoring solution. We protect people from intrusion, fire and flood - and we save lives. We believe it is a human right to feel safe and secure.
